name: dobe_drink5
desc: pink goo doberman seen from behind hugging tightly, its pursed muzzle tip is pressed flat against the other face like a deep kiss, so its mouth is completely hidden behind its own muzzle and not visible at all, no mouth, no teeth, no eye visible. The whole body barely moves: only its head and neck bob very slightly up and down by a couple of pixels like slow steady gulps, the back of its neck and throat gently pulse, a little thick pink goo oozes out from where the muzzle tip is pressed and drips down in sticky strands, arm and lower body stay still, very subtle motion, looping
